pages.title: Her ice
pages.text: Cracked ice will not hold long.

She fights on ice over black water, and it is she who decides which ice breaks - only the plates with runes cut in them she leaves be. Under the ice glides her shadow - hard to make out, and where it stops, hands rise.$(br2)The water under the ice kills faster than it looks. When she wails, the ice starts to go in sheets. Nor does she fight alone.
